datasheet.title: Hubbell Premise Wiring M-Series Rail Mounted horizontal cable manager, HM34C spec sheet

description: 3 RU M-Series horizontal cable manager, catalogue HM34C, UPC 662620553382. A steel centre plate as wide as the rack has four windows a cable crosses through. Five wire rings stand out of it on each side, 4 in (102 mm) at the front and the same behind. A hinged, removable cover closes the front. The maker says the rings align with the adaptors of a patch panel.

gaps.note: the sheet's A for 3 RU is 4.6 in (117 mm); 3 RU is 5.25 in (133.35 mm), and its two siblings' A is exactly their RU. The figure's red bar is the plate's own height, so the sheet's figure is used and not corrected.
gaps.wanted: the dimensioned customer drawing, or the maker's figure for the plate's place in the three units

gaps.note: the sheet's figure marks a dimension D for the rings behind the plate and its table gives A, B and C only. Taken as equal to C, read off the figure against it.
gaps.wanted: the dimensioned customer drawing, or the maker's figure for D

gaps.note: the sheet's figure shows each wire ring bent round where it leaves the plate and at its free end, with a hook on the post of alternate rings, and dimensions none of it. The side views draw the loop with a 11.43 mm corner radius (two wire diameters), a stand-in; the 3D loop keeps square corners and no hook is drawn. The rings are drawn in a mid steel tone so they read against the black plate; the sheet states none.
gaps.wanted: the dimensioned customer drawing, or the maker's figure for the ring's bend and hook

gaps.note: the sheet's figure shows a folded edge along the cover, the HM24C photograph a lip along the top and a name plate at the middle. The face draws a 6 mm fold along the top and foot and the plate's 58 by 12 mm box blank; the fold's width is a stand-in.

the sheet calls the cover "hinged & removable" and its figure draws it swung open; the format has no hinge, so the cover is one panel drawn fitted, and the `cover-off` configuration is the cover taken off.
gaps.wanted: a format for a hinge; nothing the maker could add

gaps.note: the sheet states no count of cables, nor a basis for one; it says only that the rings align with the patch panel's adaptors.
gaps.wanted: a maker's figure with its basis

name: hm34c

a-is-not-3-ru.note: datasheet - THE SHEET'S A, 4.6 IN (117 MM), IS SHORT OF 3 RU, 5.25 IN (133.35 MM). The figure marks A as a red bar along the plate's end, the same bar the HM14C and HM24C figures draw, and on those sheets A is 1 RU and 2 RU exactly (1.75 and 3.5 in). The bar on this sheet is 270 px against 200 for the 2 RU part's, 1.35 times, and 4.6 against 3.5 is 1.31 times: it measures the plate's own height, 4.6 in, and the sheet gives no figure for the span the part occupies. The sheet is not corrected. The ENVELOPE'S HEIGHT IS THE SHEET'S A, 116.84 mm, and `ru` is the sheet's own "3 RU": the part takes three rack units of the rail, and its plate is 16.5 mm shorter than the three units are tall. Where in those three units the plate sits is not stated; it is drawn from the rail unit's top.

attrs.note: datasheet - material, wire diameter and finish are the sheet's specification table; the cover, the pass-through holes and the corresponding vertical manager are its characteristics table; the UPC is its ordering table.

cable-capacity.note: datasheet - the sheet states no cable capacity, so none is stated here and none is estimated.

chassis.note: datasheet - 482.6 x 116.84 x 204.7. Width is B, 19 in; height is A, 4.6 in (see `a-is-not-3-ru`); ru is the sheet's 3 RU. Depth is the overall: the sheet's C, 4 in (101.6 mm) in front of the plate, the plate's thickness, and the rear extension D behind it. The sheet's own "Depth 4 in" is C alone.

ears.note: estimated - `positions` states where the part bolts, for the Rack Builder. The plate is the part's own ears, so the rail plane is the back of the plate: the front rings stand C, 101.6, out of its front, and the plate is 1.5 thick (estimated), so `at` is 103.1. The five rings behind it reach into the rack by D (see `rear-extension`). The sheet's accessories list a replacement cover and hook-and-loop ties and no rail kit, so `kits` is not stated.

front.note: estimated - the front: the plate with its four windows, five wire rings and the cover. The figure has no scale, so the ring pitch and the window sizes are read against B (see the plate's `windows`): five rings 112 mm apart, symmetric about the middle, a ring in the web between each pair of windows and one at each end, as the figure draws them. The HM34C figure reads the pitch 117 mm, 4 % wider, taken as the 112 of its smaller siblings. The cover is drawn fitted; the `cover-off` configuration leaves it off and shows the rings.

full-depth.note: `full-depth: false` - the rings reach 101.6 in front of the rail and 101.6 behind it, not the depth of the rack, so the rack unit's rear face is not claimed.

left.note: estimated - an elevation, rear on the left: each ring's wires and post, either side of the plate's edge. The right is the same, turned round.

method.note: FIGURES FROM THE MAKER'S OWN SPEC SHEET. Hubbell publishes one PDF per catalogue number, PREMISE_HM34C_spec.pdf on hubbellcdn.com (sha256 below): a features list, an ordering table, specifications, characteristics, accessories and a dimensions table, A 3 RU, 4.6 in (117), B 19 in (483), C 4 in (102), beside one isometric figure that marks A, B, C and D. The sheet's "Customer Use Drawing" link points at ecatalog.hubbell-premise.com, which does not resolve (checked 2026-10-18), so no dimensioned drawing was read: the figure is a line drawing without a scale, and everything read off it is `estimated`, with how.

rear.note: estimated - the figure draws a second set of five rings on the far side of the plate, its dimension D; they are the front's, seen from behind, with the same windows.

rear-extension.note: estimated - 101.6, as C. The figure marks a fourth dimension D for the rings behind the plate, and no table gives it. Read on the HM14C, HM24C and HM34C figures against C the same way, D is 0.98, 0.90 and 1.10 of it, so the two are taken as equal; Hubbell's own page for the HM144C, a 1-unit part that states a 4 in rear extension, agrees. No sheet says the HM34C has the same rear extension as the HM144C.

thickness.note: estimated - 1.5 mm. No Hubbell sheet states the plate's gauge for the M-Series.

top.note: estimated - an elevation: the plate's edge and the ten rings' top wires, five behind it and five in front. The cover's edge is not drawn: the configuration with it off draws the same plan.
